title: Мова й локаль
requirement_en: Use explicit uk or uk-UA for Ukrainian; uk is not a country label for British English. Never infer language from Cyrillic alone.
exceptions: No guidance for en-UK, ru or und

title: Українські літери
requirement_en: Preserve Ґ/ґ, Є/є, І/і and Ї/ї as distinct characters; never substitute similar Latin or Russian glyphs. Historical quotations remain intact.
exceptions: Do not modernize protected historical text

title: Апостроф
requirement_en: Keep U+0027, U+2019 and U+02BC exactly as supplied. An editorial proposal may discuss apostrophe choice in words such as сім’я, but never replace globally or infer correctness from adjacency.
exceptions: Names, identifiers, quotation marks and code can require other characters

title: Комбіновані знаки
requirement_en: Keep exact Unicode sequences including decomposed ї and stress marks. NFC equivalence is diagnostic only; preserve author bytes.
exceptions: Normalization needs explicit authorization

title: Правопис і джерело
requirement_en: Ask for the applicable orthographic edition and publisher policy before spelling proposals. Distinguish contemporary prose from historical quotation and accepted alternatives.
exceptions: Do not treat all older publication dates as errors

title: Змішані абетки
requirement_en: Flag suspicious Latin/Cyrillic mixtures for inspection while retaining the original. A brand, URL, formula or quoted phrase can legitimately mix scripts.
exceptions: No automatic homoglyph replacement

title: Власні назви
requirement_en: Preserve names, trademarks, capitalization, URLs and transliteration choices. Ask before translation, retransliteration or editorial modernization.
exceptions: Source ownership and quotation scope override cosmetic preferences

title: Перенесення слів
requirement_en: Use Ukrainian-aware hyphenation only after dictionary and renderer testing. Do not split grapheme clusters or inject hard hyphens into names, source strings or IDs.
exceptions: Emergency overflow treatment is a layout proposal, not spelling correction

title: Лапки й цитати
requirement_en: Discuss publisher quotation nesting and punctuation separately from content; preserve quoted words and current quote bytes until a specific change is authorized.
exceptions: Code strings and citations retain exact punctuation

title: Числа й одиниці
requirement_en: Separate localized display from stored numeric values. Use a verified uk-UA formatter for dates, currency and grouping; confirm meaning before changing ambiguous separators.
exceptions: Do not rewrite source values or identifiers

title: Форми множини
requirement_en: Use Ukrainian locale plural categories and test representative values with a verified formatter; do not assemble translated messages by suffix substitution.
exceptions: This tool is not a translation engine

title: Покриття шрифту
requirement_en: Check real font coverage for Ukrainian letters, italics, combining accents and punctuation. Cyrillic coverage alone does not demonstrate Ukrainian quality.
exceptions: No national font style is mandatory
example: Ґ Є І Ї ґ є і ї

title: Ліцензії шрифтів
requirement_en: Check the actual license for web embedding, desktop use and distribution. A free download or institutional use does not grant redistribution rights. No font files are bundled.
exceptions: Check the selected release and purchase agreement

title: Текст і виразний заголовок
requirement_en: Choose reading, expressive or hybrid intent. Expressive overlapping or condensed display lettering needs a separately readable alternative for essential information.
exceptions: A brand case is not a national norm

title: Розмір і ритм
requirement_en: Propose size and leading from audience, medium, distance and actual font metrics. A 16 px body and 1.5 leading can be a comparison starting point, not a universal Ukrainian minimum.
exceptions: Published design-system values are contextual; measure the actual output
example: compare 16/24 and 18/27 in the target layout

title: Контраст і доступність
requirement_en: Check foreground/background contrast and focus visibility in the actual UI. Colour or typographic style alone must not carry essential meaning.
exceptions: Static text checks cannot certify contrast

title: Інтервали й масштабування
requirement_en: Test user text-spacing overrides and zoom without clipping or overlap. Do not use fixed-height boxes that hide Ukrainian accents, descenders or wrapped content.
exceptions: Expressive crop is unsuitable for essential copy
example: Ї ґ Й at increased line height

title: Позначення мови
requirement_en: Set the appropriate HTML lang for Ukrainian text and mark foreign-language spans where needed; language metadata supports pronunciation but does not prove correctness.
exceptions: Do not overwrite foreign quotations

title: Переформатування
requirement_en: Test narrow reflow and long Ukrainian words at enlarged text size; prefer flexible layout over break-all or hidden overflow.
exceptions: Never insert zero-width characters into a protected token

title: Документи й читання
requirement_en: Check tagged heading order, table reading order, font embedding permissions and copy/paste in the actual PDF or Office output. Source checks do not establish native document acceptance.
exceptions: Export needs target-client inspection

title: Наголос і навчальні тексти
requirement_en: Preserve supplied stress marks and distinguish teaching or linguistic notation from ordinary prose. Do not add or remove accents without a verified source and permission.
exceptions: Absence of stress marking in ordinary prose is not an error

title: Вирівнювання й колонка
requirement_en: Compare left alignment and justified text using actual Ukrainian word lengths, hyphenation and spacing. Avoid forced line breaks whose appearance depends on one viewport.
exceptions: Poetry, tables and authored lineation can require intentional breaks

title: Тон і призначення
requirement_en: Keep the author’s register, word order and intended audience. Separate proposed copy changes from layout advice; read-only review never rewrites.
exceptions: No automatic shortening or translation

title: Межі перевірки
requirement_en: Report static findings, measurements and unrun checks separately. Native rendering, expert proofreading and host invocation remain not_checked until actually exercised.
exceptions: Guidance is not a compliance certificate
